examples.en: On my birthday my friends bought me a cake.
It always rains on my birthday.
On my birthday I had dinner with my family.
Since it is my birthday, I left work early today.
I wrote my friend's birthday on the calendar.

explain: 그냥 '생일'이 훨씬 흔하고, '생일날'은 생일 바로 그날을 강조할 때 써요. '생일 선물', '생일 파티'처럼 합쳐진 말에는 '생일'을 써요. 어른의 생일은 높여서 '생신'이라고 해요.

phrases.nuance_ko: 훨씬 더 흔하게 쓰는 말이에요. 날을 강조하지 않을 때는 '생일'이라고 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The much more common word; use it when you don't stress the day itself.

phrases.en: On my birthday morning, I ate seaweed soup.
phrases.nuance_ko: 생일 그날의 아침을 말할 때 써요. 한국에서는 생일에 미역국을 먹어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the morning of the birthday; in Korea people eat seaweed soup on their birthday.

phrases.en: Next week is my grandmother's birthday.
phrases.nuance_en: The honorific word for an elder's birthday.

explain_en: Plain '생일' is far more common; '생일날' stresses the actual day itself. In compounds like 'birthday gift' and 'birthday party', use '생일'. An elder's birthday is honored as '생신'.
